### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- DescribeAttack/ListAttacks never populate AttackDetail.AttackProperties or SubResources: both are real traffic statistics (top contributors, summarized counters) and simulated attacks carry no traffic, so the optional fields are honestly absent.

### Deferred

- InvalidResourceException is not distinguished from InvalidParameterException: CreateProtection has no cross-service resource-existence check; shield's provider.Init could query the elbv2/cloudfront/route53/ec2/globalaccelerator backends via the SetAppConfig sibling pattern, not done.
